name: Caminho Real 25
description_md:
Caminho Real 25 is a hard regional waymarked hiking route spanning 38.6 km. The trail features 2436 m of ascent and 2461 m of descent, requiring about 18 hours of walking time on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule.

This route is signposted as CR25 and is classified as difficult due to the distance and ascent. Hikers will find the path passing within 100 m of the British Cemetery of Funchal and the Museu de História Natural do Funchal. The trail also passes within 1500 m of the Igreja de Santo António.
